scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @quotan/api" "npm run dev -w @quotan/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @quotan/api && npm run build -w @quotan/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @quotan/api && npm run typecheck -w @quotan/web && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @quotan/api && npm run test -w @quotan/web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build && playwright test
